name: Better Displays Pro
author: dragosol
description: Multi-monitor settings on one wide panel: native resolution and refresh rate read from each monitor's EDID, scale, rotation, arrangement, mirroring, workspaces, and layouts remembered automatically across hotplug and Hyprland reloads.

barWidget.description: Monitor and display settings from the bar: resolution, refresh rate (EDID-accurate), scale, rotation, arrange and mirror screens, assign workspaces. One wide panel that fits 1280×720; kept layouts come back on their own.
